messages:
Priya (CS): Heads-up: LuminaHealth moved their vendor risk form deadline out by 2 business days to 2025-03-24. They want explicit DPA + SOC2 evidence and a short KMS/key-ownership blurb. Can we assemble a response pack?
Diego (Eng): I can draft the KMS flow and include the sample config for Dedicated & Private. Do we need sample terraform or just YAML snippet?
Priya (CS): YAML is fine for now. They mainly want to confirm if keys can be customer-managed and how rotation/audit logs work.
Sam (Security): Customer-managed keys are supported in Private and via an integration path for Dedicated; hosted customers use our managed KMS but we can provide exported logs and attestation. I'll add the exact limitations. Also flag: we shouldn't promise HSM serial numbers for hosted.
Nina (Solutions): I'll create a 1-page "Evidence snapshot": SOC2 artifacts we can share (scope summary, control list, auditor contact), DPA excerpt (data flows), and the KMS blurb. Helps legal review quickly.
Jules (Legal): Quick note: include the standard redaction clause and our minimum retention defaults. If Lumina needs a different retention, we should propose an addendum and route to contracts.
Diego (Eng): Adding YAML snippet now: ```kms:
  mode: customer_managed
  provider: aws-kms
  region: us-east-1
  require_iam_role: true
  rotation: 365d
  audit_export: enabled
```
Sam (Security): Adding security bullets to the sheet: how we isolate keys in Dedicated, what telemetry we ship, and acceptable export formats for logs.
Priya (CS): I'm scheduling a 20m sync with LuminaHealth on Friday 10am PT to walk through the pack. Please drop bullets in the shared doc before EOD today: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1LuminaPack_example
OpsBot: Reminder: Vendor form deadline for LuminaHealth updated to 2025-03-24.
Jules (Legal): Also flagging renewal risk: customer is evaluating multiple vendors; slow turnaround on these items increases churn risk. Recommend an enablement demo after the sync.
Nina (Solutions): I'll prep the demo checklist and include a short runbook for their security reviewer.
Priya (CS): Thanks team. I'll mark LuminaHealth as "monitoring" in Gainsight and attach the evidence snapshot once Ken/Diego/Sam confirm. :rocket:
